origin: Rules developed after v2 outcomes; prospectively declared only for later run IDs started after this freeze.

public_rules.explanation: 5 kg exceeds the declared 2 kg lifted-payload rule. This is a public-rule boundary, not a certificate that the robot cannot physically lift 5 kg. Ground-supported push is the selected legal operation.

budget.token_budget_reason: deterministic privileged expert; no language model called

profile_snapshot.scope: Bounded privileged development reference; no handle variant, no general randomized-policy or sensor-only claim. The task accepts every complete legal route. Full target AABB, ground support, no hand contact and 3 second dwell are scored from measured trace. Initial D exclusion is checked.
profile_snapshot.revision_reason: Use a different legal final action sequence: last Push/Retreat already has measured released ground-supported crouch states. Continue actual bounded joint control at the last reference, settle for measured1s, then hold6s. Skip final reposition/ReturnHands/ClearHands/StandUp. Do not truncate, splice, or reset any old run; all old safety failures remain.
controller_scope_notes: finger_reference_min_rad applies only mirrored index/middle flex/distal, including zero-open commands in StandUp; thumb2 neutral is unchanged and still physically audited
reach joint upper overrides constrain IK references, never actual simulator joint limits or actual state
ClearHands starts from fresh measured MCP and clears the reference integrator, never resets physical state
only explicit palm-only IK misses may use fallback; foot or COM constraint failures stop rather than silently accepting infeasible references
final crouch_hold keeps ordinary physical PD/gravity/balance control and original force caps; it holds references, never actual joints or free base

definition.timing: New v5 terminal route defined before its first physics execution. Earlier transport/reposition measurements informed the plan choice; previous v2/v3/v4 failures remain unchanged.
definition.scope: Observed effects of this continuous physical trace only. Does not validate arbitrary skill starts, independent low-level leaf contracts, actuator compliance, sensor-only execution, or formal admission.
definition.transport: Adjacent Touch+Push+Retreat interval: both raw hand contacts occur, target progresses toward D on ground with two feet planted, exits released and target speed <.02 m/s. No claim of simultaneous raw contact at nominal Touch exit.
definition.reposition: Only the first cycles-1 transports are followed by PlannedSteps and ReturnHands. Preserve the original measured bilateral footfall/support/reachability predicates.
definition.release: After final Touch+Push+Retreat, settle_release then hold_both, without final footfalls or standing. Every settling/holding state remains raw released with measured ground support; settling has independently measured final 1 s target/base speed bounds within the declared 8 s timeout, Hold retains original all-state base speed bounds for at least the declared 6 s. Full D/3 s dwell, original five safety rules and 1 mrad actuator limits remain necessary.
definition.preservation: Every original command interval, raw boundary and leaf fail/unknown is referenced without relabeling its success. No command or physics state is changed.

definition_role_override: Prospective executable macro skill contract for future matching-profile runs; old leaf predicates retained as diagnostic, not exact leaf-boundary acceptance.
success: All measured macro effects, complete command/shared-boundary coverage, original 1 mrad actuator compliance and strict native goal/identity verdict. Original fine-grained leaf statuses remain separately visible. No human or formal admission claim. Original shared five-rule safety review must be complete with no events; missing fields mean unknown.
